(03) Services & pricing

Built once. Hosted monthly.

Four clear services: a new website, a rebuild of the one you have, a non-profit rate and hosting-only. Builds are paid once-off; hosting is R300 a month.

(05) Process

From idea to live site.

A calm, four-stage process that keeps clients close without slowing delivery.

  1. 01

    Discover

    We talk through the business, the goal and the pages you need. You get a clear scope, price and timeline before anything starts.

  2. 02

    Design

    Layout, type and colour direction for the pages in scope. You approve the design early, before the build begins.

  3. 03

    Build

    We build the approved design as a fast, mobile-first website, then show it to you on a staging link for feedback.
